invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object, even on the branch that returns a new instance.
After execution, the write statuses are always set (either via deleteExecutor or explicitly).
The HoodieWriteConfig is always dereferenced unconditionally, so must be non-null at exit.
deleteExecutor is always used before return, implying it must be non-null.
table is dereferenced in all code paths and must be non-null at method exit.
